desc: Exchanges a temporary OAuth verifier code for a user access token.

client_id.desc: Issued when you created your application. If possible, avoid sending `client_id` and `client_secret` as parameters in your request and instead supply the Client ID and Client Secret using the HTTP Basic authentication scheme.

client_secret.desc: Issued when you created your application. If possible, avoid sending `client_id` and `client_secret` as parameters in your request and instead supply the Client ID and Client Secret using the HTTP Basic authentication scheme.

code.desc: The `code` param returned via the OAuth callback.

code_verifier.desc: The code_verifier param used to generate the code_challenge originally. Used for PKCE.

redirect_uri.desc: This must match the originally submitted URI (if one was sent).

grant_type.desc: The `grant_type` param as described in the OAuth spec.

refresh_token.desc: The `refresh_token` param as described in the OAuth spec.

output.desc: User access token and app installation information

scope.desc: Comma-separated list of scopes granted to the token.

user_id.desc: The user ID of the user corresponding to the token.

app_id.desc: ID of the app being installed or re-installed.

is_enterprise_install.desc: Boolean flag indicating whether the generated token is enterprise level token or not

expires_in.desc: Time until this credential expires, if it expires at all

id.desc: ID of the team into which the app is being installed or re-installed.

name.desc: Name of the team into which the app is being installed or re-installed.

id.desc: ID of the enterprise into which the app is being installed or re-installed.

name.desc: Name of the enterprise into which the app is being installed or re-installed.

bad_redirect_uri.desc: Value passed for `redirect_uri` did not match the `redirect_uri` in the original request.

cannot_install_an_org_installed_app.desc: Returned when the the org-installed app cannot be installed on a workspace.

workspace_denied_app.desc: Returned when the org-installed app is denied for a workspace the install would add it to, by that workspace or by the org, so it can't be added there.

invalid_client_id.desc: Value passed for `client_id` was invalid, or the `client_id` in the assertion is not a string.

invalid_refresh_token.desc: The given refresh token is invalid.

invalid_resource.desc: The `resource` in the assertion is malformed, or is not a resource tokens can be issued for.

no_user_scopes.desc: Missing user `scope` in the auth request.

oauth_authorization_url_mismatch.desc: The OAuth flow was initiated on an incorrect version of the authorization url. The flow must be initiated via /oauth/v2/authorize .

preview_feature_not_available.desc: Returned when the API method is not yet available on the team in context.

app_not_admin_approved.desc: The app has not been approved by an org admin, so no tokens can be issued for this user. Ask an org admin to approve the app before requesting a token with the `urn:ietf:params:oauth:grant-type:jwt-bearer` grant.

app_not_org_installed.desc: The app is not installed at the organization level. Using the `urn:ietf:params:oauth:grant-type:jwt-bearer` grant type requires org level app installs.

client_id_mismatch.desc: Value passed for `client_id` did not match the `client_id` in the assertion.

ema_issuer_mismatch.desc: The issuer in the assertion did not match the issuer configured for enterprise-managed auth.

invalid_audience.desc: The audience in the assertion is not one this token endpoint supports.

missing_scope.desc: Missing `scope` in the assertion. The identity assertion JWT must carry a space-delimited `scope` claim.

missing_sub_id.desc: Missing `sub_id` in the assertion. It must identify the user with a `sub_id` in the `saml-nameid` format, unless it carries an `aud_tenant` for an organization set up to accept assertions without one.

no_app_scopes_requested.desc: None of the scopes requested in the identity assertion are configured on the app. Request only scopes the app already declares.

no_approved_scopes_requested.desc: The app is approved by org admins, but none of the requested scopes are approved ones. Ask an org admin to approve the requested scopes.

user_not_authenticated.desc: The user has never authenticated via single sign-on.

no_idp_config_for_entity_id.desc: No Enterprise-Managed Authorization (cross-app access) configuration is bound to the identity provider's SAML EntityID carried in the assertion's `sub_id`. An org admin must configure External Identity / cross-app access for that identity provider before requesting a token with the `urn:ietf:params:oauth:grant-type:jwt-bearer` grant.

ema_tenant_mismatch.desc: The `aud_tenant` in an assertion without a `sub_id` is missing, or is not the ID of the organization or workspace whose identity provider issued it.

invalid_aud_tenant.desc: The `aud_tenant` in the assertion is not a string. It must be the ID of the organization or workspace whose identity provider issued the assertion.

invalid_email.desc: The `email` in the assertion is not a string.

invalid_issuer.desc: The `iss` in the assertion is not a string. It must be the issuer URL of the identity provider that issued the assertion.

invalid_jti.desc: The `jti` in the assertion is not a string. It must be a unique identifier for the assertion.

invalid_scope.desc: The `scope` in the assertion is not a string. It must be a space-delimited list of scopes.

invalid_sub.desc: The `sub` in the assertion is not a string.

invalid_sub_id_format.desc: The `format` of the `sub_id` in the assertion is not a string. The only supported format is `saml-nameid`.

missing_audience.desc: Missing `aud` in the assertion. It must name this token endpoint as an audience.

missing_client_id.desc: Missing `client_id` in the assertion. It must match the `client_id` of the app requesting the token.

expired_token.desc: The assertion has expired: its `exp` is in the past. Request a new assertion from the identity provider.

idp_keys_unavailable.desc: Slack could not fetch the OpenID Connect discovery document (`/.well-known/openid-configuration`) or the `jwks_uri` of the identity provider named by the `iss` in the assertion: the request failed or returned an HTTP error status. Retry, and if it keeps failing, check that both are served over HTTPS.

invalid_exp.desc: The `exp` in the assertion is not an integer. It must be the assertion's expiration time, in seconds since the epoch.

invalid_header_encoding.desc: The header of the assertion is not base64url-encoded JSON.

invalid_jwks.desc: The identity provider's `jwks_uri` did not return a JSON Web Key Set with a `keys` array.

invalid_jwt_format.desc: Value passed for `assertion` is not a JWT in compact serialization. It must have exactly three segments separated by `.`.

invalid_openid_provider_metadata.desc: The identity provider's OpenID Connect discovery document (`/.well-known/openid-configuration`) is not JSON with string `issuer` and `jwks_uri` fields.

invalid_payload_encoding.desc: The payload of the assertion is not base64url-encoded JSON.

invalid_signature.desc: The signature of the assertion does not verify against the identity provider's signing key named by its `kid`.

invalid_sub_id.desc: The `sub_id` in the assertion is not a JSON object. It must identify the user in the `saml-nameid` format.

invalid_token.desc: The assertion could not be verified. For example, its header has no `alg` or `kid`, its `alg` is not supported or doesn't match the signing key, or its `nbf`, `iat`, or `exp` is not a number.

invalid_typ_header.desc: The `typ` in the header of the assertion is not `oauth-id-jag+jwt`.

jwks_uri_not_https.desc: The `jwks_uri` in the identity provider's OpenID Connect discovery document is not an `https` URL.

jwt_already_used.desc: The assertion has already been exchanged for a token. An assertion can be used only once: request a new one, with a new `jti`, from the identity provider.

jwt_expired.desc: The assertion was presented before and has since expired. Request a new assertion, with a new `jti`, from the identity provider.

missing_email.desc: Missing `email` in an assertion without a `sub_id`, or it is empty. It must be the email address of the user the token is for.

missing_exp.desc: Missing `exp` in the assertion. It must be the assertion's expiration time, in seconds since the epoch.

missing_issuer.desc: Missing `iss` in the assertion. It must be the issuer URL of the identity provider that issued the assertion.

missing_jti.desc: Missing `jti` in the assertion, or it is empty. It must be a unique identifier for the assertion.

missing_sub.desc: Missing `sub` in the assertion, or it is empty.

missing_sub_id_format.desc: Missing `format` in the `sub_id` of the assertion. The only supported format is `saml-nameid`.

missing_sub_id_issuer.desc: Missing `issuer` in the `sub_id` of the assertion, or it is not a string. It must be the SAML EntityID of the identity provider.

missing_sub_id_nameid.desc: Missing `nameid` in the `sub_id` of the assertion, or it is not a string. It must be the user's SAML NameID.

missing_typ_header.desc: Missing `typ` in the header of the assertion. It must be `oauth-id-jag+jwt`.

openid_provider_issuer_mismatch.desc: The `issuer` in the identity provider's OpenID Connect discovery document does not exactly match the `iss` in the assertion.

pkce_not_allowed.desc: The app is not allowed to use the PKCE flow.

token_not_yet_valid.desc: The assertion is not valid yet: its `nbf` or `iat` is in the future. Check the identity provider's clock.

unknown_kid.desc: The `kid` in the header of the assertion does not match any signing key published at the identity provider's `jwks_uri`.

unknown_saml_issuer_for_team.desc: The `issuer` in the `sub_id` of the assertion is not a SAML identity provider configured for the organization or workspace.

unsupported_sub_id_format.desc: The `format` of the `sub_id` in the assertion is not supported. The only supported format is `saml-nameid`.

user_not_found.desc: No active user in the organization or workspace matches the user the assertion identifies by its `sub_id` NameID or, without a `sub_id`, its `email`. External guests can't be identified this way.

well_known_url_not_https.desc: The `iss` in the assertion is not an `https` URL, so the identity provider's OpenID Connect discovery document can't be fetched.
